description:
Get the PDF version of a document from Holded.

Args:
  - doc_type (string): Document type (required)
  - document_id (string): The document ID to get PDF for (required)

Returns:
  PDF file data (base64 encoded or URL).

doc_type.description: Document type: invoice, salesreceipt, creditnote, receiptnote, estimate, salesorder, waybill, proform, purchase, purchaserefund, purchaseorder

document_id.description: The document ID to get PDF for

name: holded_invoicing_get_document_pdf
title: Get Holded Document PDF
